translations.web: “Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
translations.bsb: “Why does this man speak like this? He is blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
translations.kjv: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?
translations.asv: Why doth this man thus speak? he blasphemeth: who can forgive sins but one, even God?
